text:
kevin: heads up — saw a config rollforward during the canary that correlated with a small burst of 503s. wondering how we want to classify config apply failures so oncall gets sensible alerts. cc @julia @anya

julia: can you paste the diff + which route/quota this touched? was this a console-initiated rollout or an operator/infra change?

kevin: console-initiated. diff snippet:
```
- route_quota: 10000
+ route_quota: 20000
- enable_new_routing: false
+ enable_new_routing: true
```
we flipped an opt-in flag for a cohort and about ~6% of requests to a small subset hit 503 while canary ran.

anya: if the config change is a non-breaking feature flag flip we probably don't want a full page. If the change causes upstream 5xx spikes, that should page. The hard part is mapping "config.apply failure" vs "runtime impact".

matt: proposal: extend the config apply API response with a small classification contract: `severity` (one of `info|warn|page`) and `impact_hint` (short string). Console maps `severity` -> pager. Telemetry emits `config.apply.failure.v1` with fields `tenant_count` and `error_rate`.

kevin: that sounds right. two questions: who sets `severity`? owner in the manifest? or server computes heuristics (e.g. delta in 5xx rate, percent tenants affected) and suggests a default?

julia: prefer server-computed default + owner override. Server can apply heuristics during/after rollout and surface a recommended severity; owner can explicitly set an override when they know the change is noisy but expected. audit trail required.

ops-bot: deploy:config-apply failed for rollout id `rollout-abc123` on prod — 87 invocations, 6% error rate, automatic rollback to snapshot `s-2023-11-17` executed.

anya: nice detail from the bot. For oncall we should avoid paging for sub-1% blips unless accompanying SLO breach. Suggest adding threshold fields in the schema (e.g. `page_on_error_rate_above`, `page_on_slo_breach = true/false`) so defaults are explicit.

matt: also add `exposure_window_seconds` so heuristics can detect sudden large-impact flips vs gradual changes. console can show a suggested severity and the metric that tipped the heuristics.

kevin: action items I can own: 1) add `severity` and `impact_hint` to the config API + console display, 2) emit structured telemetry events `config.apply.success/failure` with numeric `tenant_count`, `error_rate`, `exposure_window_seconds`, 3) draft default heuristics PR that computes severity and thresholds. I'll open an RFC.

julia: +1. make sure audit fields include `set_by`, `computed_by` and `override_reason`. Also plan for a read-only history UI for oncall.

kevin: opening RFC now: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/config-apply-classification-2026 . I'll ping this thread when draft PR and console mockups are up.

matt: :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — this will help reduce noisy pages. :100:
